title: Instrument Haul Amounts on Fine Arts Travel Fees for Students with a District Instrument Checkout (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Instrument haul amount.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, an instrument haul amount of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is added after the shares by the student's Fine Arts Instrument Usage checkout for the school year in status checked out (the first such checkout when several are on record): 25.00 for Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass), 10.00 for any other usage type except Summer Instrument Checkout, and nothing when there is no such checkout.

The checkout is the student's instrument checkout under the **Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program** for the same school year whose status is checked out; its usage type decides the amount.

| Student's checked-out instrument checkout for the school year | Instrument haul amount |
|---|---|
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | 25.00 |
| Percussion Equipment Usage, Woodwind Instrument Usage, Brass Instrument Usage or Orchestra String Instrument Usage | 10.00 |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | nothing |
| no checkout of the school year in status checked out | nothing |

A checkout in any other status (returned, for instance), or one of another school year, is not a checkout this amount reads.
